headline: Weathered Expanse Flips to Wardens as Toll Mounts
war_summary: The tide has turned in the Weathered Expanse since our last edition: where Colonial flags flew over six posts at the evening filing, Warden banners now command six of nine, one holds for the Colonials, and two grounds lie in ruin. The day's ledger there counted 9,810 Colonial and 12,941 Warden fallen, with Wightwalk again the busiest field at twenty-one logged actions. On the Nevish Line the Wardens have edged ahead, five posts to three, with actions recorded up to the filing hour. Mooring County stands nine Warden posts to two, one ground now demolished, and fighting flared within minutes of this dispatch. Callahan's Passage grinds on unchanged at nine Warden strongholds to one, Crumbling Post again the most worked-over ground, the mutual reckoning past seven thousand apiece. Kuura Strand and Palantine Berm have logged no post actions for hours after earlier churn; Stlican Shelf's flags have not moved since mid-afternoon, though its casualty columns still fill. Day 535 closes with the thirty-four victory towns still unclaimed and no victor named.
